models.positioning: Google's most intelligent Flash model for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
notes: Introductory Standard pricing applies through December 31, 2026; higher Standard pricing starts January 1, 2027.

models.positioning: Google general-purpose Flash model for high-throughput multimodal reasoning, coding, and agent workflows.
notes: Gemini 3.7 Flash is a stable, generally available model and remains fully supported, while Gemini 3.8 Flash is the newer Flash generation.
Google documents medium as the default thinking level, with low and high also supported; minimal is not supported.
Introductory Standard pricing runs through December 31, 2026, with higher Standard rates beginning January 1, 2027.

The model supports Batch, Flex and Priority inference, context caching, code execution, computer use (preview), file search, function calling, Google Search and Maps grounding, structured outputs, URL context and agentic video understanding.

models.positioning: Google's flagship production text-to-speech model for high-fidelity, expressive long-form and multi-speaker audio generation.
notes: Google lists Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS as generally available as of September 22, 2026.
Standard pricing uses text input tokens and audio output tokens; audio output tokens correspond to 25 tokens per second.
The model is excluded from the generic generative token calculator because its output-token dimension represents audio rather than text.

models.positioning: Google's production text-to-speech model optimized for high-throughput, low-latency and cost-efficient speech generation.
notes: Google lists Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS as generally available as of September 22, 2026 and as the production replacement for gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview.
Standard pricing uses text input tokens and audio output tokens; audio output tokens correspond to 25 tokens per second.
The model is excluded from the generic generative token calculator because its output-token dimension represents audio rather than text.

models.positioning: Google's generally available speech-to-text model for high-accuracy non-streaming transcription with language detection, diarization, word-level timestamps, and vocabulary biasing.
notes: Google announced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe as generally available on August 26, 2026, with no shutdown date currently announced.
The model accepts audio and returns text/word annotations; Google documents up to one hour of audio per request, or up to 30 minutes when diarization or word-level timestamps are enabled.
Standard pricing is $2 per 1M audio input tokens and $12 per 1M text output tokens. The model is excluded from the generic text-token calculator because the input token dimension is audio-specific.

models.positioning: Google stable Flash model balancing speed, multimodal capability, coding, and agentic execution for production workloads.
notes: Google lists gemini-3.6-flash as a stable model with no shutdown date announced.
Introductory Standard pricing applies through December 31, 2026; higher Standard pricing starts January 1, 2027.
Knowledge cutoff remains null because the cited current model documentation does not publish one.

models.positioning: Google stable low-latency Flash-Lite model optimized for high-volume agentic tasks, document parsing, extraction, and cost-sensitive multimodal workloads.
notes: Google lists gemini-3.5-flash-lite as stable with no shutdown date announced.
Standard paid pricing is $0.30 input, $0.03 cached input, and $2.50 output per 1M tokens.
Knowledge cutoff remains null because the cited current model documentation does not publish one.

models.positioning: Google stable text-only embedding model for semantic search, retrieval, clustering, classification, and similarity workflows.
notes: Google explicitly states gemini-embedding-001 remains available for text-only embedding use cases alongside the newer multimodal Gemini Embedding 2.
Standard pricing is $0.15 per 1M text input tokens; embeddings have no generative output-token price.
The model is excluded from the generative token calculator because it is input-only embedding inference.

models.positioning: Google DeepMind open-weight Gemma 4 instruction model for reasoning, coding, agentic workflows and multimodal understanding.
notes: Gemini Developer API provides hosted access to gemma-4-31b-it.
Gemma 4 is free of charge on the Gemini Developer API free tier and has no paid tier published.

models.positioning: Gemini 3.8 Flash post-training variant for approved cybersecurity use cases with multimodal input and long context.
notes: Generally available behind an allowlist; access requires Google team or Fairwind approval.
Global Standard token pricing is represented; non-global and Flex/Batch rates remain separate service tiers.

models.positioning: Google's stable low-latency native-audio Live API model for voice agents with asynchronous function calling and multimodal inputs.
notes: Shown Standard prices cover TEXT tokens only: $0.75 input and $4.50 output per 1M text tokens.
AUDIO is billed at $3.00 input and $12.00 output per 1M audio tokens (Google also publishes approximate per-minute equivalents). IMAGE/VIDEO inputs cost $1.00 per 1M tokens.
A free tier is listed by Google, but the catalog displays the paid-tier Standard text rates; mixed-modality voice costs are not comparable to text-only estimates.
Google documents no supported context caching or Batch API for this model. Its interleaved reasoning is designed to avoid reasoning-induced delay.

models.positioning: Google stable multimodal embedding model for semantic search and cross-modal retrieval across text, images, audio, video and PDFs.
notes: Displayed Standard price ($0.20 per 1M tokens) applies to TEXT embedding inputs only. Embeddings have no generative output-token charge.
Google separately bills IMAGE input at $0.45 per 1M image tokens ($0.00012/image), AUDIO at $6.50 per 1M audio tokens ($0.00016/second), and VIDEO at $12.00 per 1M video tokens ($0.00079/frame).
Batch pricing differs: $0.10 text, $0.225 image, $3.25 audio and $6.00 video per 1M corresponding input tokens.

Output embedding dimensions are configurable 128–3072 (recommended 768, 1536 or 3072). Embedding 2 vectors are NOT directly compatible with Gemini Embedding 001 vectors; migration requires re-embedding existing documents.
The generic generative text-cost calculator excludes input-only embedding inference.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per 1 million TEXT input tokens (other media separate)

models.positioning: Google's efficient production image creation and conversational editing model with 1K, 2K and 4K output and improved text rendering, references and character consistency.
notes: Standard paid API input: $1.50 per 1M text/image/video input tokens; generated IMAGE output: $30.00 per 1M IMAGE output tokens. Text and thinking output is separately priced at $7.50 per 1M text tokens; do not apply the image rate to text.
Google estimates $0.0336 per 1K image, $0.0504 per 2K image and $0.113 per 4K image in Standard mode. Input prompts, Search grounding, Batch and additional output tokens may incur separate charges.
Stable provider-native ID gemini-nano-banana-2.1. The generative text-token cost calculator is intentionally disabled because output mixes image and text tokens.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per 1 million tokens (IMAGE output; text output billed separately)

models.positioning: Google premium image generation and editing model for complex graphics, high-fidelity product mockups, brand consistency and precise text rendering.
notes: Stable provider-native model ID is gemini-3-pro-image; Nano Banana Pro is its consumer-facing name.
Standard paid API rates: $2.00 per 1M text/image input tokens and $120.00 per 1M generated IMAGE output tokens. Text and thinking output is priced separately at $12.00 per 1M text tokens.
Google's Standard estimates are $0.134 per 1K/2K image or $0.24 per 4K image; prompt/input tokens, search grounding and optional service tiers can add charges.
Not comparable to pure text-generation models on one input/output rate. Generic text token calculator is intentionally disabled.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per 1 million tokens (IMAGE output; text output billed separately)

models.positioning: Google stable multimodal conversational video-generation and editing model with video extension, upscaling and iteration through the Interactions API.
notes: Standard paid Gemini API input rate is $1.50 per 1 million input tokens across text/image/video/audio. Generated VIDEO output is $17.50 per 1 million VIDEO tokens; text output, when applicable, is $9.00 per 1 million text tokens.
Google specifies 5,792 tokens per second of 720p video, equivalent to approximately $0.10/second at the published Standard video-output rate. Other resolutions and input usage alter total cost.
Supports 3–10-second video output; video edit/extension inputs are limited to 10 seconds. The 1,048,576 context token window describes input capacity, not an output-video token quota.
Use provider-native ID gemini-omni-1.1-flash; Gemini Omni Flash is the product name. Text-only cost calculator disabled for mixed video/media pricing.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per 1 million input / VIDEO output tokens (text output separate)

models.positioning: Google's full-song music generation model for high-fidelity MP3 audio and optional lyrics, with structural coherence across verses, choruses and bridges.
notes: Google Gemini API publishes $0.08 per generated full song, billed per request (Standard paid tier); no free API tier. This is NOT a token or per-second price.
Native music generation model ID: lyria-3.5. Supports text and image prompts; output includes 44.1kHz stereo MP3 audio and lyrics.
Song length can be a couple of minutes and is guided by the prompt. There is no separate publicly specified generative max_output token count applicable to finished audio.
Music generation is its own task filter; it does not participate in generative text token pricing estimates.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per generated full song (Standard paid API)

models.positioning: Google's Preview long-context multimodal reasoning and coding model for complex agents and document analysis.
notes: Official API ID gemini-3.1-pro-preview; preview availability may change.
Standard tiered input/output token prices per million: $2/$12 for prompts <=200K, $4/$18 above 200K; caching and grounding are additional.
Fixed token calculator disabled because the rate depends on prompt length.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per million tokens, <=200K or >200K prompt tier

models.positioning: Google image-generation and editing endpoint for efficient interactive visual creation; distinct from Nano Banana 2.1.
notes: Native API ID gemini-3.1-flash-image is different from gemini-nano-banana-2.1 already in the catalog.
Standard paid rates: text/image input $0.50 per million tokens; IMAGE output $60 per million tokens; text/thinking output $3 per million tokens.
Provider image estimates are $0.045 for 0.5K, $0.067 for 1K, $0.101 for 2K and $0.151 for 4K output; additional inputs and grounding cost extra.
Mixed image/text pricing is not a generic fixed token calculator rate.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per million tokens: IMAGE output only, text output separate

models.positioning: Google Live voice endpoint with continuous audio, background thinking and asynchronous agent tool use.
notes: Official API ID gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking is distinct from gemini-3.8-live.
Standard TEXT input/output $0.75/$4.50 per million text tokens; AUDIO input/output $3/$12 per million audio tokens; image/video input $1 per million tokens.
Audio sessions use multiple native meters; text calculator disabled.
Only non-blocking async function calls supported. Clients must use interaction_status to detect a truly idle session.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per million TEXT tokens; audio/video priced separately
